hardware_exclusions.reason: LM 2026-10-05. The sensor was failing. In the equilibrium recording before this run (Eq_E9_A) it drifts away from the ring from about 600 s and sits at the -10 V input limit from 905 s (626 samples); it starts the run at -6.95 V (34.7 C), where the anterior sensor of every other eye starts at -4.5 to -5.9 V; and it is dead (+10 V) in the two later runs on this eye (Ex_E9_C, Ex_E9_LB). Effect of excluding it: human anterior sclera n 9 -> 8, initial 31.4 -> 30.9 C, final 9.8 -> 9.1 C, excursion 21.6 -> 21.8 C; no other site changes.
